description: Many contacts, one or more tags: remove tags from up to 500 existing subscribers in one call, identified by emails, externalIds, or subscriberIds. Never creates contacts: subscribers that do not exist are reported in notFound. Needs the subscribers:tag scope; the broader subscribers:write scope also satisfies it. Use this to roll back or reconcile a derived-tag backfill.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

tags.description: Tag names to remove from every matched subscriber.

name: bulk_remove_subscriber_tags

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `bulk_remove_subscriber_tags` MCP tool.

failures.description: List of per-subscriber failure (up to 50) records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

notFound.description: Identifiers that did not resolve, grouped as emails, externalIds, and subscriberIds.

tags.description: Normalized tag names removed from every matched subscriber.

unchanged.description: Subscribers that did not carry any of the tags.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
